name: Riley Chung
biography: Riley is an American child actor. She lives in London with her parents, three older sisters and dog. All four girls in the family are actors. Riley has recently wrapped on Feature Films "The Hunger Games: The Ballad Of Songbirds & Snakes" 'Sunrise' and "Le Marché De Noël" Riley has Korean and European heritage.
